subject: Urgent: price-approval backlog & forecast exposure — ClearWind
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance-ops@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: price-approval backlog & forecast exposure — ClearWind

Team —

Quick heads-up: ClearWind (Deal DW-2027-1147) is currently in legal review but procurement just flagged that the pricing we quoted in March has been approved by the customer only verbally. There are pending discount approvals in the deal desk queue that need to be closed before we can mark the revenue as committed in the forecast. If we can’t clear this, Q3 committed number will be pulled down by ~$1.2M ARR (estimate attached).

Can Deal Desk and Finance confirm the following by EOD Tuesday?
- Karthik: which approvals are still open (tier and approver)?
- Vanessa: what is the current forecast treatment if approvals aren’t in by Thursday close?
- Marissa: any open legal/contract blockers from your side?

I attached a quick export from the pricing queue (discount_log_20270516.csv) — note the two line items that triggered the exception: 25% off list on platform and waived integration fee. Customer contact is Seth Kramer (procurement@clearwind.com).

Objective: run a 48-hour price-clearance sprint and, if needed, temporarily move the amount to "at-risk" in the forecast so FP&A has a clean committed number for executive reviews.

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: price-approval backlog & forecast exposure — ClearWind

Jonas —

Thanks for flagging. Quick status: both the platform discount and integration waiver were submitted as an exception on 2027-05-10 and are awaiting VP approval (level: Sales VP override). Approver is Priya Natarajan but she’s OOO until Wednesday. I have escalated to the Deal Desk pod lead and asked for a temporary authorized approver.

Plan I propose:
1) If Priya can’t sign off by Wednesday COB, we route to the Interim Approver (head of Sales Ops) for an emergency approval to protect forecast visibility.
2) If approval is still blocked by contractual/legal redlines, we mark $1.2M as "at-risk" in the forecast and include notes referencing the exception id.

I’ll push the exception to priority and loop in Priya’s backup. Will update by 14:00 PT.

- Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Deal Desk
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, finance-ops@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: price-approval backlog & forecast exposure — ClearWind

Adding context from FP&A: if we don’t get formal documented approval by Thu close, we need to move $1.2M from COMMITTED -> PROBABLE for the weekly executive pack. That will affect our stated Q3 commit rate and may trigger a post-mortem with Sales leadership.

What I need from Deal Desk today:
- Exception IDs and approver history for the two line items (I saw the raw export but need exception trail to stand up the decision in the pack).
- ETA on DocuSign MSA turnaround: is legal waiting on commercial redlines from ClearWind? If so, attach the redline (we have clearwind_MSA_redline.pdf on the thread).

If we can get either: (a) an approved email from Priya or (b) a confirmed DocuSign envelope routed to Procurement by EOD Thu, we will keep the amount COMMITTED. Otherwise FP&A will downgrade.

Vanessa Ortiz
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Seth Kramer <seth.kramer@clearwind.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearwind.com, legal@clearwind.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 12:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: price-approval backlog & forecast exposure — ClearWind

Hi Jonas / team —

Thanks for the transparency. Procurement has approved the commercial terms on their side; Legal is finishing an internal review and should return the signed MSA to us by Thursday morning PDT. We are not asking for any additional discount beyond what was originally discussed, but Legal did mark a couple of minor language clarifications (I attached them to this reply).

Seth Kramer
Procurement Lead
ClearWind Energy
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: price-approval backlog & forecast exposure — ClearWind

Great — thank you Seth.

Karthik / Vanessa / Marissa: next steps confirmed:
- Karthik: if Priya hasn’t approved by 17:00 PT Wednesday, route to Interim Approver and send approval email to FP&A (vanessa) immediately.
- Vanessa: prepare forecast note (we’ll downgrade to PROBABLE only if DocuSign isn’t in flight by Thu 12:00 PT).
- Marissa: coordinate with Legal to get the signed MSA into DocuSign and share the envelope link with procurement and finance.

I’ll update the exec pack with this contingency and mark the deal as "at-risk" until we see signed DocuSign or approver email. Thanks for the quick responses — moving this off the open list is priority today.

Jonas
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
